# Stuarts Septic & Land

> Licensed and insured septic contractor based in Coinjock, North Carolina,
> serving northeastern North Carolina and southeastern Virginia.
> Owned and operated by Tyler Stuart.

Phone: (252) 489-8773
Open for emergencies 24/7
Website: https://stuartsseptic.com

## Credentials
- North Carolina Level 4 septic installer, the top state classification, covering engineered and alternative systems
- Virginia Master Alternative septic system installer
- Certified Infiltrator products installer
- Fully insured for residential and commercial work

## Services
- Septic system installation, conventional, pump and alternative
- Septic repair, including cracked tank lids, failed pumps and collapsed lines
- Septic pumping and routine maintenance
- Drainfield repair, replacement and expansion
- Septic inspections for buyers, sellers and lenders
- Infiltrator chamber systems
- Rock and pipe drainfields
- Ditching, drainage, grading and site work

## Service area
Ten counties in northeastern North Carolina: Currituck, Dare, Camden,
Pasquotank, Chowan, Gates, Hyde, Beaufort, Tyrrell and Pitt.
Also southeastern Virginia.
Service area business. Crews travel to the property. There is no public storefront.

## Notes
Estimates are free and given in writing after a site visit.
Permits through the county health department are handled as part of the job.
The crew backfills and grades the excavation. Seeding and landscaping are not included.
